title: Anna's Breakfast
text:
Anna likes breakfast. Every morning she eats bread with butter and drinks a cup of tea. Sometimes she eats an apple too. She says breakfast gives her energy.

At lunch, Anna often eats soup. On Friday she goes to a restaurant with her friend Tom. Tom orders pizza and orange juice. Anna orders a salad.

questions.text: What does Anna drink with her breakfast?
What does Tom order at the restaurant?
How does Anna probably feel after her breakfast?
How do Anna and Tom probably feel about spending time together?

vocabulary.definition: the first meal of the day
the strength to be active and do things
a place where you buy and eat meals
a dish of cold vegetables, often served as a side or light meal

paragraph_translations: Anna lubi śniadanie. Każdego ranka je chleb z masłem i pije filiżankę herbaty. Czasami je też jabłko. Mówi, że śniadanie daje jej energię.
Na obiad Anna często je zupę. W piątek idzie do restauracji ze swoją przyjaciółką Tomem. Tom zamawia pizzę i sok pomarańczowy. Anna zamawia sałatkę.
